title: #18 Matt Neal, Pyramid Motorsport BMW M3, BTCC 1991
note: Very dark blue (almost black) M3 with a yellow band along the lower body from bumper to bumper and a blue band under it on the sill, big white number board with the red Esso header on the front door, Shell on the rear quarter. Band heights and the number board measured on the nose-left Super Touring Register photo of Fenwick #18 (6216, Thruxton) against the wheelbase and door, and checked with the STR photo of Hall #18 (4723, other side: Shell, Dunlop, yellow and blue bands) and the Getty front view of Fenwick (Thruxton 22 September, 2201200918: yellow front bumper with a blue lip). TV caption drawings (round 12 Thruxton) are dark and blurry: black car, large white number board, yellow marks low down. Wheels: bronze/gold BBS mesh with a polished lip, from the Hall STR photo (on track); no standing photo of this car found. Neal drove #18 at round 7 (Silverstone GP, his BTCC debut). Only a Getty rear view of that day exists (2201221866): British Gas and Resource on the rear screen, Cosack (UK) Ltd and Taco on the boot panel, so his side lettering is unknown: the door is left plain and the Shell roundel copied from Hall's car.
